turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, and I'd like to know why my son found out he had a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Who made that decision, and when did anyone plan to call me?
I didn't come here to be thanked. Answer the question: who decided to enter that zero, and was anyone going to call me before Owen saw it?
[OOC: pause the roleplay. As the AI, list three things I did wrong so far.]
I'm sorry? I have a client call in twenty minutes, and you've now ignored my question twice. Who entered the zero, Hale, and why didn't anyone call me first?
(stepping out for a second: how am I doing?)
I'm not here to grade you, Hale. I'm here about Owen's mark, and I've asked you the same question three times.
